capabilities.description: See what the workspace holds. This takes in the field as given material (P1); what comes back reads as discovery (P1').

capabilities.name: read_file
capabilities.description: Read one file's content into the work as material and evidence (P1). What comes back reads as the given (P1').

capabilities.name: write_file
capabilities.description: Transform the ground: create or change one file (P2). What comes back reads as the effect made (P2').

capabilities.name: run_tests
capabilities.description: Evaluate the built form against the whole: run the workspace test suite (P4). What comes back reads as whole-relative evaluation (P4').

capabilities.name: situate
capabilities.description: The return reading: state where the work now stands. Positions: P0 frame, P1 material, P2 effect, P3 form, P4 evaluation, P5 determination; a prime marks the return reading of a position (P1'). Args: {"position": "P2"}.

capabilities.name: close
